national-income-growth.synthesis:
- Highest elimination value = **classification + direction**: sector, capital type, intangible/tangible, real/financial, substitute/complement/inferior, nominal/real.
- Recurrent mechanism = **saving → investment/capital formation → output**, mediated by productivity/ICOR/capital-output ratio.
- National-income questions reward exact boundaries: **domestic vs national/resident; gross vs net; current vs constant price; value added vs final expenditure**.
- “Growth” questions repeatedly test overclaiming: growth alone does not imply poverty reduction, employment expansion, equality or development.
- UPPCS adds basic definitions and factor-of-growth/human-capital associations rather than deeper national-accounting algebra.

inflation.synthesis:
- Recurrent traps: **price level vs inflation rate; inflation vs disinflation vs deflation; demand-pull vs cost-push/structural; headline vs core; CPI vs WPI vs GDP deflator.**
- UPSC repeatedly tests financing channels: **monetised/new-money financing is more inflationary** than borrowing from existing saving.
- Institution questions require current framework, not memorised obsolete base years.
- Winner/loser questions are conditional: unexpected inflation on **fixed nominal contracts** benefits debtors and hurts creditors; avoid blanket “producers always benefit”.

planning-reform.synthesis:
- UPSC emphasis = institutional status + plan objective + reform effects, not plan trivia alone.
- UPPCS = significantly more chronology/body-person/plan-theme recall.
- Permanent note should know **1st/2nd/3rd/Plan Holiday/4th/5th/Rolling/Annual Plans/8th–12th** landmarks; avoid obsolete numerical growth targets unless a PYQ directly demands them.
- 1991 reforms should be understood as **stabilisation (short-run macro correction)** + **structural adjustment (longer-run supply/institutional reform)**, with LPG as the common mnemonic rather than a complete reform taxonomy.

economic-thinkers.synthesis:
- UPPCS theory questions are mostly **one-hop association**: thinker ↔ book, theory ↔ propounder, theory ↔ core proposition.
- Highest-value set: Smith, Keynes, Malthus, Sen, Myrdal, Hirschman, Kaldor, Cannan, Henry George, Thompson, Gresham.
- Avoid expanding into Nobel-year/current-award trivia unless the taxonomy later assigns it to a current-affairs node.

upsc.label: Financial inclusion / rural credit / delivery architecture
Bank regulation / bank types / NBFC distinction
Bank balance sheet / lending risk / stressed assets

banking-financial-inclusion.synthesis:
- Highest elimination value = **institution category → what it can accept/lend/issue → regulator → deposit insurance → central-bank access**.
- UPSC repeatedly converts current banking developments into durable classification questions: NBFC vs bank; PB vs SFB; UCB/PACS; PSB governance; foreign-bank WOS.
- Inclusion questions move from scheme names → **delivery architecture** (Lead Bank, Service Area, BC, SHG, PSL, TReDS, FI-Index).
- NPA questions prefer **mechanism/purpose**, not current NPA ratios.
- Basel questions test **why capital/liquidity buffers exist**, not memorisation of every transition schedule.

upsc.label: RBI functions / legal architecture / lender of last resort

money-rbi-monetary-policy.synthesis:
- Memorise **direction chains**, not just definitions: tool ↑/↓ → bank reserves/funding cost → credit/money → demand → inflation/growth.
- Distinguish **stock/aggregate identity** questions from **credit-creation process** questions.
- RBI PYQs now include **balance-sheet/income, governance and CBDC** in addition to classic repo/CRR/SLR.
- Monetary transmission bridge: policy rate → overnight rates → bank funding/deposit/lending rates + bond yields → consumption/investment → output/inflation.

financial-markets.synthesis:
- First elimination axis = **maturity + issuer + security/claim + regulator + tradability**.
- UPSC increasingly asks unfamiliar instrument names but solvable by family: debt/equity/derivative/pooled vehicle/money-market claim.
- Keep **legal rights** distinct: lender vs owner; coupon vs dividend; priority at liquidation; conversion rights.
- Treat market statistics, index constituents and investment ceilings as current-layer examples only.

digital-payments.synthesis:
- Core traps = **operator/owner** (RBI vs NPCI), **settlement mode** (real-time gross vs batch), **underlying money** (bank deposit vs CBDC), **fee bearer** (MDR), **data residency**.
- UPI international reach is dynamic; durable note = interoperability/cross-border linkage possible, not a permanent country list.

budget-fiscal-policy.synthesis:
Prioritise:
1. **Revenue vs capital** classification.
2. **RD / FD / PD** arithmetic and direction.
3. Fiscal expansion/contraction and **crowding out**.
4. FRBM: purpose, statements, historical recommendations vs current framework.
5. Public debt/liability classification; off-budget borrowing.
6. Disinvestment and non-debt capital receipts.
7. UPPCS Budget-specific figures as **replaceable current-affairs**, never frozen permanent facts.

taxation.synthesis:
Prioritise:
1. Direct vs indirect; progressive/regressive/proportional.
2. VAT → ITC → GST anti-cascading logic.
3. CGST/SGST/IGST + destination principle.
4. Tax-to-GDP, **buoyancy vs elasticity**.
5. Cess vs surcharge vs divisible pool.
6. BEPS, transfer pricing, GAAR, indirect transfers.
7. Agricultural-income boundaries.
8. Historical tax instruments (Equalisation Levy / Angel Tax) only as dated PYQ/reform anchors, not current taxes.

upsc.label: World Bank Group / MDBs / new development banks
WTO agreements / agriculture / TRIMs / trade facilitation

international-institutions.synthesis:
- Highest elimination value = **term/report/agreement → correct institution**.
- WTO questions prefer **fine distinctions**: goods vs services; trade-distorting vs permitted support; dated force/ratification; exceptions.
- IMF questions repeatedly test **SDR ≠ currency**, reserve tranche, lending-window attribution, reports.
- WBG/MDB questions test **who lends to whom**, public vs private sector, headquarters/origin, and governance—not just names.
- Trade-agreement questions often use **membership/partner lists that age quickly** → retain agreement architecture + explicitly dated examples only.

external-sector.synthesis:
- Core UPSC pattern = **classification + direction of effect**, not memorising the latest dollar/rupee number.
- Elimination pivots: current vs financial flow; FDI vs FPI; debt vs non-debt; reserve vs flow; appreciation vs depreciation; NEER vs REER; market determination vs central-bank intervention.
- Trade-data questions recur, but taxonomy explicitly makes the **figures/rankings replaceable**. Final notes need a current-affairs slot, not frozen statistics.

government-schemes.synthesis:
- UPSC repeatedly converts a familiar scheme into a **fine-print elimination test**: compulsory vs voluntary; target group; whether an entitlement is guaranteed; exact scheme boundary; institutional owner; whether a benefit belongs to a sibling scheme.
- Highest-return memory format = **Scheme → objective → target → ministry/agency → one eligibility/exclusion → financing/type → famous trap**.
- “Ayushman Bharat”, “skill mission”, “social security” are umbrellas/families, not safe single labels; distinguish components.
- Rural-employment law is a live correction point: old MGNREGA PYQs remain historically examinable, but current law changed in 2026.

industry-labour-infrastructure.synthesis:
- High-elimination distinctions: **industry policy vs infrastructure-finance institution vs regulator**; **MSME definition vs PSL treatment**; **CSR applicability vs valid CSR activity**; **old labour Acts vs current Codes**.
- Weight/base-year questions age rapidly. Preserve the **concept and publisher/agency**, update the current base/threshold in the correction layer.

poverty-employment.synthesis:
- UPSC: concept-first, often asks **why a line differs**, what an index actually measures, or best-fit unemployment type.
- UPPCS: adds committee chronology, author/term recall and numeric trends.
- Permanent payload should make all **method/definition** questions answerable without freezing transient poverty ratios or unemployment rates.

indices-reports.synthesis:
- Highest-return table = **Index/report | producer | components | current-status trap**.
- Never memorize a current rank in the permanent layer; attach rank through the Current Affairs layer at revision time.
- Distinguish **historical publisher at time of PYQ** from **current publisher** (especially GHI).

social-concepts.synthesis:
- Pure recall + one-line concept recognition.
- Five compact cards are sufficient; no Sociology-theory expansion is justified by taxonomy/PYQs.
